description: HORIZON LAYER (derivative instrument, genuinely new): the substrate measures every conservation residual at LEVEL only (violation counts per invariant) via the conservation-audit junctions, residual-shape-discovery, and model-opportunity-scan report resolvers - but NOTHING measures a residual's RATE OF CHANGE. A residual can be nonzero-but-shrinking (self-healing) or small-but-accelerating (about to break); level cannot tell them apart. DESIGN: per conservation invariant, compute the recent-window vs prior-window residual ratio from execution history (client-side date buckets; NEVER combine a datetime comparison with another predicate - SurrealQL silently drops the conjunct) and classify CONVERGING / FLAT / DIVERGING; emit a substrateGap when ratio exceeds a divergence threshold. Fire on divergence-RATE, not level. MEASURED EVIDENCE (this audit): the structure-residual proxy (organic new-arm introductions per day, excluding test/nonexistent probe arms) diverged recent-3-day mean 33.7/day vs prior-3-day 12.7/day = 2.66x over the 38k-row execution window; with probe arms included it is 3.51x (a partially self-inflicted, probe-driven component - the level instruments show none of this because they read a snapshot). NEGATIVE CONTROL / FALSIFIER (both directions REQUIRED): the detector must FIRE on an unplanted diverging residual computed live from execution history (e.g. the organic new-arm rate above, which no operator planted), AND must stay SILENT on a genuinely flat residual - the daily failure-fraction proxy measured slope +0.0012/day (28.8% prior-3 -> 32.6% recent-3, within the 6-82% day-to-day noise band) is the flat negative control it must NOT flag. A detector that fires on a replayed/planted series but not on this organic divergence, or that flags the flat failure-fraction, is falsified. IMPLEMENTATION HINT: extend an already-wired single-file report resolver that already emits a residual/opportunity report (model-opportunity-scan or residual-shape-discovery are live, single-file, already have call sites) to add the per-invariant recent-vs-prior ratio to its report body plus a gap emission on divergence - helper-first / new-file splits are dead code and the semantic gate refuses them, so the derivative computation and its call site must land in the same file in one goal.
